stock.description: Qingdao AInnovation Technology Group Co., Ltd., through its various subsidiaries, focuses on developing, researching, and selling artificial intelligence-powered software and hardware solutions across China. The company's core offerings include ManuVision, an intelligent machine vision platform designed for edge-based inspection; MatrixVision, an intelligent edge video platform that seamlessly integrates edge computing with deep learning capabilities; and Orion, a powerful distributed machine learning platform. These advanced technologies serve a range of industries, notably manufacturing and finance. The firm, initially operating as Shenzhen AInnovation Technology Co., Ltd., rebranded to its current name in December 2020. Founded in 2018, its corporate headquarters are located in Qingdao, China.
